reviews.review: Still in early access but it is already fun. I see great potential and popularity. I predict to be played next 10 years by many players who love to play with friends and shoot some aliens together.

So the game has the potential to be great. However it is clearly dead as finding a pvp lobby currently is impossible. All you ever get is "no public lobbies found". Clearly there is a low player count as you can see on steam charts. However the devs continually tell us those numbers are incorrect and there are on average 1000 players at any one time. Yet I (and a few others) never manage to find a lobby. Whenever this is brought up the devs tell us the game is very active (everyone must log off whenever i try to search for a game) and the devs remove comments and kick people from the discord for bringing up the issue. Apparently the main way to get a full lobby is to arrange one in the discord (devs advice), which is odd advice considering there is always "1000 players online".

There is nothing wrong with admitting there is a low player count, I want a game to succeed. The devs need to start being transparent and honest. Banning people from discords and deleting comments from people who paid money for the game who raise genuine concerns about player count isn't right. The lengths the devs are prepared to go to hide the obvious truth about the player count is astounding.

Today was the official launch day, the steam charts show 25 active players. i've search for a lobby and found one with one player in. After that ended it was back to no lobbies found.

EDIT: Since posting this review (3 hours ago) the devs appear to have fixed the "no public lobbies found" issue. instead now it states "all lobbies are full or private". Further adding to the theory of trying to hide a low player count. 

Take my advice, this game isnt worth your money and neither are the devs as they have proved they do not care about their players with how the feel comfortable enough to lie to us and tell us we're wrong based on our own experience. stick with L4D2 or even (and it pains me to say this) Back 4 Blood.

Update: the devs have now finally admitted that there is a low player count in their discord. further confirming that they were hiding a low player count and banning people for TELLING THE TRUTH is completely out of order.
Left 4 Dead in Space with Aliens

I'm writing this review because I genuinely enjoy this game and hope to see more people play it and enjoy it like I do. The more people getting into this game the better it can get. Even though this game is in early access having played it a good amount, (I've played it on game pass before so the steam hours aren't the only amount of time I have on this game) I can see the game being an amazing game when its finished, though as of now its still really fun. I would recommend getting it wholeheartedly.

To be more specific the guns are fun to use and though there aren't many they make up for it by having different variants of the guns throughout the maps and they don't just look cool they rip through the alien hordes in a very satisfying way. Same with the special weapons and equipment you can pick up. Overall, I like it and hope anyone who gives it a try, will like it as well.

So yeah, also cheers to the dev team for listening to the player feedback all the time!

Anacrusis is a really fun and charming game that I am excited to see developed, and have already watched it come a long way from where it was when my partner first gifted it to me. It is a game that builds upon the style and mechanics of Left 4 Dead, albeit themed much differently, but the retro futuristic space theming is very fun and there is much to love about it.

As it stands right now, there isn't a whole lot of it to experience just yet, with three campaign chapters of varying lengths and a fourth that is available now but still awaiting some redesigns and voice acting. They are still really fun to play through with a few friends though, and once you are done with those there are some really great community made campaigns and survival maps to check out. The developers have made this game very accessible to the modding community, and are even encouraging the making of your own character models, animations and accessories. It has even been taken a step further so that everyone in your lobby is able to see what kind of custom models you are using without needing to find and install everything themselves. This is optional of course and can be just kept totally vanilla through settings, but it is really fun for everyone to see things the same as the rest of your lobby.

The current focus of the developers right now is Versus Mode™, which anyone who played Left 4 Dead should be well familiar with the concept of. It plays very much the same, except it is being tuned to make it more in favour of the alien team, so you can really have a lot of fun making your friends go through absolute hell. Then when it is your turn to suffer, every inch of ground you gain over them feels like a real achievement. It also even plays well enough without having complete teams, so no more having to wait an unreasonably long time for that 8th person who still hasn't joined the lobby. 2v2 or even 1v1 games are perfectly viable. It mostly affects the time it takes to respawn as a special, but there will be some more tweak-able settings for this kind of thing before you start the game, such as how fast this is or whether you have AI specials helping you to make up for missing players. You even have the option to play solo just to practice playing as the aliens against a bunch of speedy bot player. As it is right now, versus is very early in development so there is some features yet to come for the specials you can play as, and of course plenty of bugs the need to get ironed out, but it is already in a really fun state to play.

Last of all I would like to say that if you enjoy playing this game you should consider joining the official discord server. Everyone there is really friendly, and it is a great place to get a group together to play the game with a full party. It's also a great place to suggest any new ideas you have for either the game itself or stuff for the modders to make. Follow the success story of Summer Lance™!

In short; this game is a whole lot of fun even now in it's early access state and it is only going to continue to get better and better. This review will naturally become pretty outdated!
